name: mainModel
meaning: base model slot filled by ScnObject_InitWithAltModels in FallingGate_Create

name: modelIndex
meaning: TYPE decoded to 0..4 (after the 10 is removed); indexes gateModels and g_fallingGateAnims

name: closedAtStart
meaning: CLOSED property, but only when a Train (class 0x87) exists; otherwise always 1

name: closed
meaning: current state (1 closed); the reply to msg 0x72

name: busy
meaning: 1 while moving; switch messages are ignored. Never cleared after a single-activation move, which is what latches it.

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: the gate froze the Wolf for its camera shot; msg 0xf is sent when the move ends

name: cameraActive
meaning: a scripted camera shot started by msg 0x1f is running

name: cutCamera
meaning: CUTCAMERA property: nonzero → CamScriptFlags 2 (cut in, blend out); 0 → 3 (blend in and out)

name: cameraReleased
meaning: 1 at Init and 0 when a shot starts; set to 1 only in a compiled-out if(0) branch

name: keepCamera
meaning: TYPE >= 10: the camera is not released at the end of the move, only by msg 0x20

name: camera
meaning: IDCAMERA setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos}

name: solidBox
meaning: ScnObject_GetFirstSolidBox; the crush test region once translated to pos

name: retriggered
meaning: set when msg 0x1f arrives while busy or already toggled; cleared by msg 0x20; suppresses a new camera shot

name: unk100
meaning: zeroed by Init; no reader found
